FACT FLAG E6 (APPLIED) — this card was id=name_base_eight and asserted a base-eight joke told by Wolszczan and Frail. There is no such joke; the octal reading of 1257 is a numerical accident with no connection to the name, and attributing it to the discoverers was a fabrication. Replaced with the verifiable fact: PSR 1257+12 is a sexagesimal sky coordinate, 12h57m right ascension and plus 12 degrees declination.
